claims.claim_text: A system for managing vendor-agnostic configure to order (CTO) and quote to order (QTO) processes, comprising: a Real-Time Data Mesh (RTDM) configured to aggregate, standardize, and normalize real-time data from diverse sources, including ERPs, CRM systems, and market intelligence, for structured and unstructured data processing, the RTDM implementing a data lake and comprising a plurality of purposive data stores, each purposive data store configured to persist standardized data aligned to particular analytical or operational requirements, the purposive data stores including at least a compliance data store, a pricing data store, and a market intelligence data store; a Single Pane of Glass User Interface (SPOG UI) configured to facilitate user interaction with features for instant conversion of shopping carts into subscription-based models, dynamic pricing tools, and real-time visibility into vendor performance and strategic partnerships; an Advanced Analytics and Machine-Learning (AAML) Module for analyzing product compatibility, optimizing subscription models, dynamic pricing strategies, sentiment analysis, trend forecasting, and behavioral analytics based on deep learning capabilities and machine learning algorithms; a Vendor-Agnostic CTO/QTO Integration Module (VACIM) comprising: a Process Standardization Engine configured to identify variations in vendor-specific quoting processes and uniformly implement processes across vendors to enforce uniform quoting logic using a rule engine based on predefined rule sets; a Vendor Data Transformation Gateway configured to convert raw vendor data into a standardized format; and an Adaptive Rebate Management System configured to perform dynamic rebate calculations.
The system of claim 1, wherein the RTDM is configured to perform an ETL process for data integration and normalization to ensure uniformity and accessibility.
The system of claim 1, further comprising a Geographical Market Mapper to align product offerings with regional demand patterns and compliance requirements.
The system of claim 1, wherein the SPOG UI integrates a one-click conversion feature to streamline the transition to subscription-based models.
The system of claim 1, wherein the AAML Module integrates with the Vendor Compatibility Analyzer for assessing product interoperability across vendors.
The system of claim 1, further comprising a Global Pricing Harmonizer to ensure pricing parity across different markets, considering currency fluctuations and purchasing power parity.
The system of claim 1, wherein the VACIM dynamically adjusts processes and pricing strategies based on machine learning-informed insights into market trends and vendor performance.

patent_title: Systems and methods for performing vendor- agnostic CTO/QTO (configure to order/quote to order)
